maddeler.e:
ترتكبين (form VIII)
# تَرْتَكِبِينَ (tartakibīna) /tar.ta.ki.biː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of اِرْتَكَبَ (irtakaba)
# تُرْتَكَبِينَ (turtakabīna) /tur.ta.ka.biː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of اِرْتَكَبَ (irtakaba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
